notes: CPython 3.11 is integrated through Chaquopy. Existing implementation includes a loopback WSGI host, bounded request handling, multi-host routing, metrics and Binder lifecycle controls. Host-side tests exist. Complete Android device acceptance, security hardening and independent signed package distribution before status becomes available.

existing_implementation.acceptance: Android device/API matrix, physical-device lifecycle and security acceptance remain open.
